'''Reggi''' was a guard in the [[New Republic]] following the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Reggi accompanied [[Nadura]], a New Republic [[ambassador]], to the [[planet]] [[Corvus]] in the hope of seeing the planet join the [[New Republic Senate|Senate]]. Nadura met with [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]], who had forced the people of [[Calodan]] to labor in [[Factory|factories]]. Nadura demanded that Elsbeth stand down and turn herself in to stand trial for her crimes. Elsbeth refused to step down, however, and ordered her [[Scout guard|guards]] to [[Death|kill]] the ambassador. After two of their fellow guards were gunned down, Reggi ordered everyone else back to the ship before being killed by Magistrate Elsbeth with her [[beskar spear]].<ref name="TPoH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Reggi appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' episode "[[The Path of Hate]]" and was voiced by [[Steve Blum]]. The episode premiered alongside the rest of the series<ref name="TPoH" /> on [[May 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' Trailer Revealed}}</ref>
